  -- Result: Decided to engage WebSurfer to search for release dates of all three films with specific queries.
- Agent: WebSurfer

  -- Observation: Found results indicating Amélie was released theatrically in France on April 25, 2001.
  -- Thought: Confirmed Amélie's release date. Now need to search for the other two films.
  -- Result: Reported back to Planner with Amélie's release date (April 25, 2001, France).

The Subtask Name: Ambiguous Title Resolution and Second Data Gathering
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed the result from WebSurfer regarding Amélie and noted the need to resolve the ambiguous title "The Time to Love" and find Beginners' release date.
  -- Observation: Amélie's date is confirmed. The Time to Love search results showed variations (with/without "The"), and Beginners' date is still unknown.
  -- Thought: Need to clarify if "The Time to Love" exists as an exact title and find its release date. Also need Beginners' release date.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search for "The Time to Love" with exact title focus and for Beginners' release date.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "The Time to Love film release date" and "The Time to Love release date 1927".
  -- Observation: Found results for "Time to Love" (1927) but mostly without the initial "The". Confirmed a 1927 film exists but title ambiguity remains.
  -- Thought: The exact title "The Time to Love" might not exist; the closest match is "Time to Love" (1927). Need to confirm this and find Beginners' date.
  -- Result: Reported back to Planner with findings on "Time to Love" (1927) release date (June 18, 1927, US) and noted title ambiguity.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed the WebSurfer results and noted the title ambiguity for "The Time to Love" and the need for Beginners' release date.
  -- Observation: "Time to Love" (1927) is the closest match, released June 18, 1927. Amélie is April 25, 2001. Beginners' date is still missing.
  -- Thought: Need to confirm Beginners' release date to complete the comparison.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search for Beginners' release date.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "Beginners 2010 release date" and related queries.
  -- Observation: Found results indicating Beginners was released in 2010, with festival premieres in 2010 and wide release in 2011.
  -- Thought: Confirmed Beginners' release date. Now have all three dates: Time to Love (1927), Amélie (2001), Beginners (2010).
  -- Result: Reported back to Planner with Beginners' release date (2010).
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed all gathered data and compared the release dates.
  -- Observation: Time to Love (1927) is the earliest, followed by Amélie (2001), then Beginners (2010).
  -- Thought: The earliest film is Time to Love (1927), but the task asks for "Amelie Or The Time To Love or Beginners". Since "The Time to Love" is ambiguous, but "Time to Love" (1927) is the closest match, it is the earliest.
  -- Result: Concluded that "The Time to Love" (or "Time to Love" 1927) was released earlier than Amélie and Beginners.
